{{Top|leg}}
'''''Gravik-nez''''' was an ancient art of [[Unarmed combat/Legends|hand-to-hand combat]] originating on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Affa/Legends|Affa]]. [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] was equipped with a faulty [[SkillWare|subroutine]] for this martial art. As a result, his attempts to employ ''gravik-nez'', such as when he was body-checked by the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Jabba's Gamorrean guards|guard]] [[Thok (Gamorrean guard)/Legends|Thok]] on board the [[Khetanna/Legends|sail barge]] of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], were less than successful.<ref name="Henchmen">{{SW|url=news/barely-tolerable-alien-henchmen-of-the-empire-part-2|series=Barely Tolerable: Alien Henchmen of the Empire|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO]]'', C-3PO's demonstration of his martial skill was played up for comedy.
